name: gr_mantel_equality_compl_not_connected
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) : ¬ Gᶜ.Connected
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2), ¬ Gᶜ.Connected
informal: The complement of an extremal triangle-free graph is disconnected — Uses Mathlib2.bld4_mantel_equality_complete_bipartite at step 1 to get s with 2|s| = n and Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s); then Gᶜ has no edge between s and sᶜ; if n = 0 Connected fails by emptiness, otherwise both sides are nonempty and a Gᶜ-walk from s to sᶜ would need a crossing edge.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2 → ¬Gᶜ.Connected
